name: Bo kho
summary: Báo Kon Tum lists bò khô among dried foods at the weekend market. A later article names thịt bò hun khói as a provincial 3-star OCOP product at the center stall. The articles do not say these are one cut. A price is Check on arrival.
howToEat: A method was not printed for bò khô or for thịt bò hun khói. Check on arrival.
Both names stay. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen meets on Saturday and Sunday. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal puts the pine-hill grounds on Hùng Vương in xã Măng Đen, Quảng Ngãi. Báo Kon Tum, on that portal, puts the same pine hill on Hùng Vương in thị trấn Măng Đen, Kon Plông, and another of its articles puts the market at Vườn thông by the district central square. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
The OCOP smoked beef is at the center stall with the smoked pork and the smoked buffalo.
seoDescription: Bò khô is on Báo Kon Tum’s dried-food list. Thịt bò hun khói is a provincial 3-star OCOP name at the market’s center stall. A price is Check on arrival.
